description: Bilingual multi-document accessibility knowledge base for RAG retrieval.

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content requires accessible implementation for image, icon, button, chart, media.
content.summary_zh: 非文本内容需要有可访问的文本替代方案。
content.official_text_en:
All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose, except for the situations listed below.

Controls, Input

If non-text content is a control or accepts user input, then it has a name that describes its purpose. (Refer to Success Criterion 4.1.2 for additional requirements for controls and content that accepts user input.)

Time-Based Media

If non-text content is time-based media, then text alternatives at least provide descriptive
identification of the non-text content. (Refer to Guideline 1.2 for additional requirements for media.)

Test

If non-text content is a test or exercise that would be invalid if presented in text , then text alternatives at least provide descriptive identification of the non-text
content.

Sensory

If non-text content is primarily intended to create a specific sensory experience , then text alternatives at least provide descriptive identification of the non-text
content.

CAPTCHA

If the purpose of non-text content is to confirm that content is being accessed by
a person rather than a computer, then text alternatives that identify and describe
the purpose of the non-text content are provided, and alternative forms of CAPTCHA
using output modes for different types of sensory perception are provided to accommodate
different disabilities.

Decoration, Formatting, Invisible

If non-text content is pure decoration , is used only for visual formatting, or is not presented to users, then it is implemented
in a way that it can be ignored by assistive technology .
content.intent_en: WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content requires accessible implementation for image, icon, button, chart, media.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Non-text Content 相关的内容时获得等价的信息、操作能力或反馈。
requirements_en: Provide text alternatives for meaningful non-text content.
Use empty alt text for decorative images.
Icon-only controls need an accessible name.
requirements_zh: 有意义的 img 元素必须提供准确的 alt 文本。
纯装饰图片应使用 alt=""。
只有图标的按钮必须提供 aria-label 或可见文本。
复杂图表应提供简短说明，并在附近提供更完整的数据或解释。

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) requires accessible implementation for audio, video, media.
content.summary_zh: 预录的纯音频或纯视频内容需要提供等价的媒体替代内容。
content.official_text_en:
For prerecorded
audio-only and prerecorded video-only media, the following are true, except when the audio or video is a media alternative for text and is clearly labeled as such:

Prerecorded Audio-only

An alternative for time-based media is provided that presents equivalent information for prerecorded audio-only content.

Prerecorded Video-only

Either an alternative for time-based media or an audio track is provided that presents
equivalent information for prerecorded video-only content.
content.intent_en: WCAG 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) requires accessible implementation for audio, video, media.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) 相关的内容时获得等价的信息、操作能力或反馈。

requirements_zh: 为纯音频提供文字稿。
为纯视频提供文字描述或音频轨道。
在 audio/video 附近放置可访问的替代内容链接。

If any audio on a web page plays automatically for more than 3 seconds, either a mechanism is available to pause or stop the audio, or a mechanism is available to control audio

ability to use the whole page, all content on the web page (whether or not it is used
to meet other success criteria) must meet this success criterion. See Conformance Requirement 5: Non-Interference .

content.summary_zh: 普通文本与背景的对比度至少为 4.5:1，大号文本至少为 3:1。
content.official_text_en:
The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:

Large Text

Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1;

Incidental

Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component , that are pure decoration , that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant
other visual content, have no contrast requirement.

Logotypes

Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced) requires accessible implementation for text, button, link, form.
content.summary_zh: 文本对比度应达到更高的 AAA 标准。
content.official_text_en:
The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 7:1, except for the following:

Large Text

Large-scale text and images of large-scale text have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1;

Incidental

Text or images of text that are part of an inactive user interface component , that are pure decoration , that are not visible to anyone, or that are part of a picture that contains significant
other visual content, have no contrast requirement.

Logotypes

Text that is part of a logo or brand name has no contrast requirement.

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio requires accessible implementation for audio, media.
content.summary_zh: 语音音频中的背景声音应足够低、可关闭或不存在。
content.official_text_en:
For prerecorded
audio-only content that (1) contains primarily speech in the foreground, (2) is not an audio
CAPTCHA or audio logo, and (3) is not vocalization intended to be primarily musical expression
such as singing or rapping, at least one of the following is true:

No Background

The audio does not contain background sounds.

Turn Off

The background sounds can be turned off.

20 dB

The background sounds are at least 20 decibels lower than the foreground speech content,
with the exception of occasional sounds that last for only one or two seconds.

Note
Per the definition of "decibel," background sound that meets this requirement will
be approximately four times quieter than the foreground speech content.

content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Low or No Background Audio 相关的内容时获得更高等级的无障碍体验。
requirements_en: WCAG 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio requires accessible implementation for audio, media.
requirements_zh: 提供无背景音或低背景音版本。
提供关闭背景音的控制。

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.4.8 Visual Presentation requires accessible implementation for text, article, reading.
content.summary_zh: 大段文本应支持用户调整前景/背景、行宽、对齐和间距。
content.official_text_en:
For the visual presentation of blocks of text , a mechanism is available to achieve the following:

- Foreground and background colors can be selected by the user.

- Width is no more than 80 characters or glyphs (40 if CJK).

- Text is not justified (aligned to both the left and the right margins).

- Line spacing (leading) is at least space-and-a-half within paragraphs, and paragraph spacing is at least 1.5 times larger than the line spacing.

- Text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200 percent in a way that does not require the user to scroll horizontally to read a line of text on a full-screen window .

Note 1
Content is not required to use these values. The requirement is that a mechanism is available for users to change these presentation aspects. The mechanism can be provided by the browser or other user agent. Content is not required to provide the mechanism.

Note 2
Writing systems for some languages use different presentation aspects to improve readability and legibility. If a presentation aspect in this success criterion is not used in a writing system, content in that writing system does not need to use that presentation setting and can conform without it. Authors are encouraged to follow guidance for improving readability and legibility of text in their writing system.
content.intent_en: WCAG 1.4.8 Visual Presentation requires accessible implementation for text, article, reading.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Visual Presentation 相关的内容时获得更高等级的无障碍体验。

content.summary_en: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow requires accessible implementation for responsive, layout, mobile, table.
content.summary_zh: 内容在较小视口或放大时应能重排，不应要求用户双向滚动。
content.official_text_en:
Content can be presented without loss of information or functionality, and without requiring scrolling in two dimensions for:

- Vertical scrolling content at a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels ;

- Horizontal scrolling content at a height equivalent to 256 CSS pixels .

Except for parts of the content which require two-dimensional layout for usage or meaning.

Note 1
320 CSS pixels is equivalent to a starting viewport width of 1280 CSS pixels wide at 400% zoom. For web content which is designed to scroll horizontally (e.g., with vertical text), 256 CSS pixels is equivalent to a starting viewport height of 1024 CSS pixels at 400% zoom.

Note 2
Examples of content which requires two-dimensional layout are images required for understanding (such as maps and diagrams), video, games, presentations, data tables (not individual cells), and interfaces where it is necessary to keep toolbars in view while manipulating content. It is acceptable to provide two-dimensional scrolling for such parts of the content.
content.intent_en: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow requires accessible implementation for responsive, layout, mobile, table.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Reflow 相关的内容时获得等价的信息、操作能力或反馈。
requirements_en: Allow content to reflow at small viewport widths.
Avoid fixed-width layouts that require two-dimensional scrolling.
requirements_zh: 布局应使用响应式 CSS，例如 flex、grid、media query。
容器宽度应避免写死为大于视口的固定宽度。

1.4.10 Reflow Content can be presented without loss of information or functionality, and without requiring scrolling in two dimensions for:

- Vertical scrolling content at a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels ;

- Horizontal scrolling content at a height equivalent to 256 CSS pixels .

Except for parts of the content which require two-dimensional layout for usage or meaning.

Note 1
320 CSS pixels is equivalent to a starting viewport width of 1280 CSS pixels wide at 400% zoom. For web content which is designed to scroll horizontally (e.g., with vertical text), 256 CSS pixels is equivalent to a starting viewport height of 1024 CSS pixels at 400% zoom.

Note 2
Examples of content which requires two-dimensional layout are images required for understanding (such as maps and diagrams), video, games, presentations, data tables (not individual cells), and interfaces where it is necessary to keep toolbars in view while manipulating content. content.summary_en: WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus requires accessible implementation for tooltip, popover, hover, focus.
content.summary_zh: 鼠标悬停或键盘焦点触发的附加内容应可关闭、可悬停并保持可见。
content.official_text_en:
Where receiving and then removing pointer hover or keyboard focus triggers additional content to become visible and then hidden, the following are true:

Dismissible

A mechanism is available to dismiss the additional content without moving pointer hover or keyboard focus, unless the additional content communicates an input error or does not obscure or replace other content;

Hoverable

If pointer hover can trigger the additional content, then the pointer can be moved over the additional content without the additional content disappearing;

Persistent

The additional content remains visible until the hover or focus trigger is removed, the user dismisses it, or its information is no longer valid.

Exception: The visual presentation of the additional content is controlled by the user agent and is not modified by the author.

Note 1
Examples of additional content controlled by the user agent include browser tooltips created through use of the HTML title attribute [ HTML ].

Note 2
Custom tooltips, sub-menus, and other nonmodal popups that display on hover and focus are examples of additional content covered by this criterion.

Note 3
This criterion applies to content that appears in addition to the triggering component itself. Since hidden components that are made visible on keyboard focus (such as links used to skip to another part of a page) do not present additional content they are not covered by this criterion.
content.intent_en: WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus requires accessible implementation for tooltip, popover, hover, focus.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Content on Hover or Focus 相关的内容时获得等价的信息、操作能力或反馈。
requirements_en: Hover or focus triggered content must be dismissible, hoverable, and persistent.
Provide keyboard-friendly tooltip and popover behavior.
requirements_zh: Tooltip/Popover 应能通过 Esc 或明确按钮关闭。
鼠标移动到附加内容上时不应立即消失。
焦点移开或用户关闭前应保持可见。

content.official_text_en:
All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying
function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just
the endpoints.

Note 1
This exception relates to the underlying function, not the input technique. For example,
if using handwriting to enter text, the input technique (handwriting) requires path-dependent
input but the underlying function (text input) does not.

Note 2
This does not forbid and should not discourage providing mouse input or other input
methods in addition to keyboard operation.

If keyboard focus can be moved to a component of the page using a keyboard interface , then focus can be moved away from that component using only a keyboard interface,
and, if it requires more than unmodified arrow or tab keys or other standard exit
methods, the user is advised of the method for moving focus away.

Note
Since any content that does not meet this success criterion can interfere with a user's
ability to use the whole page, all content on the web page (whether it is used to
meet other success criteria or not) must meet this success criterion. See Conformance Requirement 5: Non-Interference .

content.official_text_en:
If a keyboard shortcut is implemented in content using only letter (including upper- and lower-case letters), punctuation, number, or symbol characters, then at least one of the following is true:

Turn off

A mechanism is available to turn the shortcut off;

Remap

Active only on focus

The keyboard shortcut for a user interface component is only active when that component has focus.

content.summary_en: WCAG 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable requires accessible implementation for timer, session, form.
content.summary_zh: 有时间限制的内容需要允许关闭、调整或延长，除非时间限制必不可少。
content.official_text_en:
For each time limit that is set by the content, at least one of the following is true:

Turn off

The user is allowed to turn off the time limit before encountering it; or

Adjust

The user is allowed to adjust the time limit before encountering it over a wide range
that is at least ten times the length of the default setting; or

Extend

The user is warned before time expires and given at least 20 seconds to extend the
time limit with a simple action (for example, "press the space bar"), and the user
is allowed to extend the time limit at least ten times; or

Real-time Exception

The time limit is a required part of a real-time event (for example, an auction),
and no alternative to the time limit is possible; or

Essential Exception

The time limit is essential and extending it would invalidate the activity; or

20 Hour Exception

The time limit is longer than 20 hours.

Note
This success criterion helps ensure that users can complete tasks without unexpected
changes in content or context that are a result of a time limit. This success criterion
should be considered in conjunction with Success Criterion 3.2.1 , which puts limits on changes of content or context as a result of user action.

content.summary_en: WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide requires accessible implementation for animation, carousel, marquee, auto update.
content.summary_zh: 移动、闪烁、滚动或自动更新的内容需要能暂停、停止或隐藏。
content.official_text_en:
For moving, blinking , scrolling, or auto-updating information, all of the following are true:

Moving, blinking, scrolling

For any moving, blinking or scrolling information that (1) starts automatically, (2)
lasts more than five seconds, and (3) is presented in parallel with other content,
there is a mechanism for the user to pause , stop, or hide it unless the movement, blinking, or scrolling is part of an activity
where it is essential ; and

Auto-updating

For any auto-updating information that (1) starts automatically and (2) is presented
in parallel with other content, there is a mechanism for the user to pause, stop,
or hide it or to control the frequency of the update unless the auto-updating is part
of an activity where it is essential.

Note 1
For requirements related to flickering or flashing content, refer to Guideline 2.3 .

Note 2
Since any content that does not meet this success criterion can interfere with a user's
ability to use the whole page, all content on the web page (whether it is used to
meet other success criteria or not) must meet this success criterion. See Conformance Requirement 5: Non-Interference .

Note 3
Content that is updated periodically by software or that is streamed to the user agent
is not required to preserve or present information that is generated or received between
the initiation of the pause and resuming presentation, as this may not be technically
possible, and in many situations could be misleading to do so.

Note 4
An animation that occurs as part of a preload phase or similar situation can be considered
essential if interaction cannot occur during that phase for all users and if not indicating
progress could confuse users or cause them to think that content was frozen or broken.

Note 1 For requirements related to flickering or flashing content, refer to Guideline 2.3 . Note 2 Since any content that does not meet this success criterion can interfere with a user's ability to use the whole page, all content on the web page (whether it is used to meet other success criteria or not) must meet this success criterion. See Conformance Requirement 5: Non-Interference . Note 3 Content that is updated periodically by software or that is streamed to the user agent is not required to preserve or present information that is generated or received between the initiation of the pause and resuming presentation, as this may not be technically possible, and in many situations could be misleading to do so. Note 4 An animation that occurs as part of a preload phase or similar situation can be considered essential if interaction cannot occur during that phase for all users and if not indicating progress could confuse users or cause them to think that content was frozen or broken. content.official_text_en:
New

When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.

Note 1
Where content in a configurable interface can be repositioned by the user, then only the initial positions of user-movable content are considered for testing and conformance of this success criterion.

Note 2
Content opened by the user may obscure the component receiving focus. If the user can reveal the focused component without advancing the keyboard focus, the component with focus is not considered visually hidden due to author-created content.

content.summary_en: WCAG 2.4.13 Focus Appearance requires accessible implementation for focus, button, link, form.
content.summary_zh: 键盘焦点指示器应具有足够尺寸和对比度。
content.official_text_en:
New

When the keyboard focus indicator is visible, an area of the focus indicator meets all the following:

- is at least as large as the area of a 2 CSS pixel thick perimeter of the unfocused component or sub-component, and

- has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 between the same pixels in the focused and unfocused states.

Exceptions:

- The focus indicator is determined by the user agent and cannot be adjusted by the author, or

- The focus indicator and the indicator's background color are not modified by the author.

Note 1
What is perceived as the user interface component or sub-component (to determine the perimeter) depends on its visual presentation . The visual presentation includes the component's visible content , border, and component-specific background. It does not include shadow and glow effects outside the component's content, background, or border.

Note 2
Examples of sub-components that may receive a focus indicator are menu items in an opened drop-down menu, or focusable cells in a grid.

Note 3
Contrast calculations can be based on colors defined within the technology (such as HTML , CSS, and SVG). Pixels modified by user agent resolution enhancements and anti-aliasing can be ignored.

content.official_text_en:
For functionality that can be operated using a single pointer , at least one of the following is true:

No Down-Event

The down-event of the pointer is not used to execute any part of the function;

Abort or Undo

Completion of the function is on the up-event , and a mechanism is available to abort the function before completion or to undo the function after completion;

Up Reversal

The up-event reverses any outcome of the preceding down-event;

Essential

Completing the function on the down-event is essential .

Note 1
Functions that emulate a keyboard or numeric keypad key press are considered essential.

Note 2
This requirement applies to web content that interprets pointer actions (i.e., this does not apply to actions that are required to operate the user agent or assistive technology).

2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation For functionality that can be operated using a single pointer , at least one of the following is true:

No Down-Event

The down-event of the pointer is not used to execute any part of the function;

Abort or Undo

Completion of the function is on the up-event , and a mechanism is available to abort the function before completion or to undo the function after completion;

Up Reversal

The up-event reverses any outcome of the preceding down-event;

Essential

Completing the function on the down-event is essential .

Note 1
Functions that emulate a keyboard or numeric keypad key press are considered essential.

Note 2
This requirement applies to web content that interprets pointer actions (i.e., this does not apply to actions that are required to operate the user agent or assistive technology). content.summary_zh: 指针目标大小至少应达到 WCAG 2.2 AA 的最小要求，或满足间距/例外条件。
content.official_text_en:
New

The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels , except when:

Spacing

Undersized targets (those less than 24 by 24 CSS pixels) are positioned so that if a 24 CSS pixel diameter circle is centered on the bounding box of each, the circles do not intersect another target or the circle for another undersized target;

Equivalent

The function can be achieved through a different control on the same page that meets this criterion;

Inline

The target is in a sentence or its size is otherwise constrained by the line-height of non-target text;

User Agent Control

The size of the target is determined by the user agent and is not modified by the author;

Essential

A particular presentation of the target is essential or is legally required for the information being conveyed.

Note 1
Targets that allow for values to be selected spatially based on position within the target are considered one target for the purpose of the success criterion. Examples include sliders, color pickers displaying a gradient of colors, or editable areas where you position the cursor.

Note 2
For inline targets the line-height should be interpreted as perpendicular to the flow of text. For example, in a language displayed vertically, the line-height would be horizontal.

3.2.6 Consistent Help New If a web page contains any of the following help mechanisms , and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple web pages within a set of web pages , they occur in the same order relative to other page content, unless a change is initiated by the user: - Human contact details; - Human contact mechanism; - Self-help option; - A fully automated contact mechanism. Note 1 Help mechanisms may be provided directly on the page, or may be provided via a direct link to a different page containing the information. Note 2 For this success criterion, "the same order relative to other page content" can be thought of as how the content is ordered when the page is serialized. The visual position of a help mechanism is likely to be consistent across pages for the same page variation (e.g., CSS break-point). The user can initiate a change, such as changing the page's zoom or orientation, which may trigger a different page variation. This criterion is concerned with relative order across pages displayed in the same page variation (e.g., same zoom level and orientation). WCAG 3.2.6 Consistent Help requires accessible implementation for help, form, support. Keep help mechanisms in a consistent relative order when present. consistent help support

content.official_text_en:
For web pages that cause legal commitments or financial transactions for the user to occur, that modify or delete user-controllable data in data storage systems, or that submit user test responses, at least one of
the following is true:

Reversible
Submissions are reversible.

Checked
Data entered by the user is checked for input errors and the user is provided an opportunity to correct them.

Confirmed
A mechanism is available for reviewing, confirming, and correcting information before finalizing the submission.

content.official_text_en:
For web pages that require the user to submit information, at least one of the following is true:

Reversible
Submissions are reversible.

Checked
Data entered by the user is checked for input errors and the user is provided an opportunity to correct them.

Confirmed
A mechanism is available for reviewing, confirming, and correcting information before finalizing the submission.

content.summary_en: WCAG 3.3.7 Redundant Entry requires accessible implementation for form, checkout, multi step.
content.summary_zh: 同一流程中用户已输入的信息不应要求重复输入，除非必要。
content.official_text_en:
New

Information previously entered by or provided to the user that is required to be entered again in the same process is either:

- auto-populated, or

- available for the user to select.

Except when:

- re-entering the information is essential ,

- the information is required to ensure the security of the content, or

- previously entered information is no longer valid.

content.summary_en: WCAG 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) requires accessible implementation for login, authentication, form.
content.summary_zh: 认证流程不应要求用户完成认知功能测试，除非提供替代或辅助机制。
content.official_text_en:
New

A cognitive function test (such as remembering a password or solving a puzzle) is not required for any step in an authentication process unless that step provides at least one of the following:

Alternative

Another authentication method that does not rely on a cognitive function test.

Mechanism

A mechanism is available to assist the user in completing the cognitive function test.

Object Recognition

The cognitive function test is to recognize objects.

Personal Content

The cognitive function test is to identify non-text content the user provided to the website.

Note 1
"Object recognition" and "Personal content" may be represented by images, video, or audio.

Note 2
Examples of mechanisms that satisfy this criterion include:

- support for password entry by password managers to reduce memory need, and

- copy and paste to reduce the cognitive burden of re-typing.
content.intent_en: WCAG 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) requires accessible implementation for login, authentication, form.
content.intent_zh: 帮助用户在使用与 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) 相关的内容时获得等价的信息、操作能力或反馈。

content.summary_en: WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value requires accessible implementation for button, custom component, modal, tab, switch.
content.summary_zh: 用户界面组件的名称、角色和值必须能被程序识别，并在变化时通知辅助技术。
content.official_text_en:
For all user interface components (including but not limited to: form elements, links and components generated by scripts),
the name and role can be programmatically determined ; states , properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set ; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents , including assistive technologies .

Note
This success criterion is primarily for web authors who develop or script their own
user interface components. For example, standard HTML controls already meet this success
criterion when used according to specification.

pattern.modal-form 弹窗表单 弹窗表单组件的无障碍实现模式。 弹窗表单应使用原生 dialog 元素，或使用 role="dialog"、aria-modal="true" 和 aria-labelledby。 打开弹窗后，焦点应移动到弹窗标题、首个错误字段或第一个可交互控件。 关闭弹窗后，焦点必须返回打开弹窗的触发按钮。 弹窗内必须提供可键盘操作的关闭按钮，Esc 键应关闭弹窗。 弹窗打开时，背景页面内容不应进入 Tab 顺序。 表单控件必须有 label，并通过 for/id 正确关联。 校验错误应设置 aria-invalid="true"，并通过 aria-describedby 关联错误说明。 提交成功、保存失败等状态消息应使用 role="status"、role="alert" 或 aria-live。 不要只依赖颜色表示错误状态。 所有弹窗内交互元素必须有清晰的 :focus-visible 样式。 弹窗表单 模态表单 表单校验 只用键盘能否打开弹窗、填写表单、提交、关闭弹窗。 弹窗打开后焦点是否进入弹窗，关闭后是否回到触发按钮。 Tab 和 Shift+Tab 是否不会跑到背景页面内容。 Esc 是否能关闭弹窗。 屏幕阅读器是否能读出弹窗标题、字段名称、错误信息和提交状态。 弹窗有可访问标题，表单字段有 label，错误说明通过 aria-describedby 关联，并提供可键盘操作的按钮。 弹窗缺少 dialog 语义，输入框缺少 label，按钮使用 div 模拟，辅助技术难以理解和操作。

requirements_en: Accessible search and filter results pattern with labelled controls, stable focus behavior, live result count announcements, semantic result lists, and keyboard-operable filters.
requirements_zh: 搜索区域应使用 form role="search" 或带清晰标签的搜索表单。
搜索输入框、筛选下拉框、复选框等控件必须有 label。
筛选条件变化不应在未说明时触发重大上下文变化；需要自动更新时应保持焦点稳定。
结果数量、加载中、无结果、筛选已应用等动态状态应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite"。
结果列表应使用语义列表、article 或合适的结构表达每条结果。
清除筛选、应用筛选、分页按钮都必须可键盘操作并有可访问名称。
不要只用颜色表示当前筛选状态或无结果状态。
分页和结果区域的焦点顺序应符合视觉和操作逻辑。
如果结果自动更新，不要把焦点强行移动到结果区。
所有输入、按钮、链接和分页控件应有清晰 :focus-visible 样式。

content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.

requirements_en: Accessible drag-and-drop sortable list pattern with semantic list structure, keyboard reordering alternatives, item-specific controls, focus preservation, and live position announcements.
requirements_zh: 拖拽排序不能是唯一操作方式，必须提供按钮或键盘方式上移、下移、移到开头、移到末尾。
列表应使用 ol、ul 或语义明确的结构表达顺序。
每个项目的移动按钮必须有包含项目名称的可访问名称。
排序变化应通过 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite" 公告，例如“已将任务 A 移到第 2 位”。
拖拽手柄、移动按钮和项目操作都必须可键盘操作。
目标区域或放置位置不能只靠颜色提示，应有文本、边框或状态说明。
触控目标应足够大，并给相邻目标留出间距。
不要使用 tabindex 大于 0 来控制排序焦点。
排序后焦点应保留在被移动项目或对应操作按钮附近。
如果实现鼠标拖拽，也要保留等价的键盘和单指针操作。

content.summary_en: Accessible Rich Text Editor (WYSIWYG) component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 富文本编辑器组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Rich Text Editor (WYSIWYG) component pattern.
requirements_zh: 编辑区域必须有清晰 label，可使用 label 元素或 aria-label。
工具栏按钮必须使用 button 元素，每个按钮有可访问名称。
格式切换按钮（加粗、斜体、下划线等）应维护 aria-pressed 状态。
编辑区域应支持 Tab 进入和离开，不应造成键盘陷阱。
插入链接时应提供输入链接文本和 URL 的对话框，并正确管理焦点。
插入图片时必须强制填写 alt 文本，不可跳过。
列表、引用、标题等块级格式应使用语义 HTML（ol/ul/blockquote/h1-h6）。
颜色选择不应是唯一传达信息的方式；文字颜色必须满足对比度要求。
撤销/重做操作应可键盘触发，并有状态公告。
字符计数、保存状态等动态信息应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live。
不要用 contenteditable 实现而不提供完整键盘支持和语义暴露。
所有工具栏按钮和编辑区域应有清晰 :focus-visible 样式。

content.summary_en: Accessible Video Player component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 视频播放器组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Video Player component pattern.
requirements_zh: 视频必须提供字幕（captions），并允许用户开关字幕。
预录视频应提供音频描述或媒体替代文本。
播放器控件（播放/暂停、音量、进度条、全屏、字幕）必须使用 button 或原生控件。
每个控件必须有可访问名称，状态变化需反映在 aria-pressed 或等价属性中。
进度条滑块应使用 input type="range" 或带 role="slider" 的完整实现。
音量控制应支持键盘调整，不只有拖动。
自动播放视频必须提供暂停按钮，且不自动播放音频。
键盘应支持 Space 播放/暂停、方向键快进/快退/调音量。
全屏切换应公告当前状态。
不要使用只有鼠标能操作的控件。
视频不应包含每秒超过 3 次的闪烁内容。

good_examples.explanation_en: This component example illustrates an accessible or inaccessible interaction pattern.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 视频有字幕轨、回退内容和标签，额外控件有可访问名称。

content.summary_en: Accessible Chart Data Visualization component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 图表数据可视化组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Chart Data Visualization component pattern.
requirements_zh: 图表必须有文本替代，例如隐藏的数据表格、描述性标题或摘要。
图表数据点应可键盘导航，使用 tabindex="0" 或 focusable 元素包裹。
每个数据点应有可访问名称，包含类别和数值。
颜色不应是区分数据系列的唯-方式，应附加图案、标签或边框区分。
图表颜色必须满足非文本对比度 (3:1) 和文本对比度要求。
交互式图表应支持方向键在数据点之间移动，并公告当前数据。
图例应可键盘操作，并在点击/按键时切换数据系列可见性。
缩放和平移操作必须有键盘替代方式（如按钮缩放、输入范围选择）。
动态数据更新应使用 aria-live 公告变化。
不要只渲染 canvas 或 SVG 而不提供任何可访问层。

content.summary_en: Accessible Infinite Scroll / Load More component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 无限滚动加载组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Infinite Scroll / Load More component pattern.
requirements_zh: 自动加载新内容时，必须使用 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite" 公告加载状态。
加载区域应提供"加载更多"按钮作为键盘可触发的替代方式。
新加载的内容应追加在已有内容之后，不要插在已有内容前面。
加载完成后焦点不应被强制移动到新内容。
加载失败或没有更多内容时应明确公告。
不要只依赖滚动事件触发加载，尤其是无法检测滚动的辅助技术场景。
加载中应提供视觉指示器（如 spinner），且该指示器有 ARIA 状态标记。
提供跳过已加载内容的导航方式（如回到顶部或跳转到加载按钮）。
新内容追加前后的 DOM 顺序必须与视觉阅读顺序一致。

content.summary_en: Accessible Chat Messaging Interface component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 即时通讯聊天界面组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Chat Messaging Interface component pattern.
requirements_zh: 消息列表应有语义结构，每条消息可用 article 或 listitem 包裹。
消息列表区域应有 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby，且标记为 aria-live="polite"。
新消息到来时应公告发送者和消息摘要，但不能强制移动焦点。
消息输入框必须有 label，发送按钮必须有可访问名称。
在线状态、对方正在输入等动态状态应使用 aria-live 公告。
消息时间戳、发送状态不应只依赖颜色表达。
提供跳转到消息列表开头的快捷操作。
文件/图片附件必须有文本说明。
键盘应支持 Enter 发送消息（在中文输入法组合输入期间不应触发发送）。
不要在没有用户确认的情况下自动滚动到旧消息。

content.summary_en: Accessible Shopping Cart Drawer component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 购物车侧边抽屉组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Shopping Cart Drawer component pattern.
requirements_zh: 抽屉面板应使用 role="dialog" 或 region，并提供 aria-label="购物车" 等描述性名称。
打开抽屉后焦点应移到抽屉内第一个可交互元素。
关闭抽屉后焦点必须返回触发按钮（如导航栏的购物车图标按钮）。
抽屉内商品数量、总价变化应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite" 公告。
关闭按钮、删除商品按钮、增减数量按钮必须使用原生 button 并有可访问名称。
每个商品应有图像 alt 文本、名称、价格、数量和操作按钮。
Esc 应可关闭抽屉。
抽屉打开时其余页面内容不应进入 Tab 顺序。
总价区域应有明确 heading 或等价标记。
不要用 div 模拟按钮，不要缺失关闭后的焦点回归。

content.summary_en: Accessible Faceted Filter Panel component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 分面筛选面板组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Faceted Filter Panel component pattern.
requirements_zh: 筛选面板应使用 form 包裹，并用 fieldset 和 legend 分组每类筛选条件。
每类筛选（价格区间、品牌、类别等）的控件必须有 label。
已应用的筛选条件应在顶部展示为可移除的标签/chip，并有关联说明。
筛选结果数量变化应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite" 公告。
每个可移除筛选标签应有可访问名称（如"移除 品牌：苹果 筛选"）。
清除全部筛选按钮必须可键盘操作并有清楚名称。
筛选变化不应在没有预先说明的情况下自动刷新页面；如自动刷新则保持焦点。
价格滑块的当前范围应有数字输入替代。
复选框、单选按钮应使用原生控件。
不要只依赖颜色表示已选筛选条件。

content.summary_en: Accessible Context Menu (Right-Click) component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 右键上下文菜单组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Context Menu (Right-Click) component pattern.
requirements_zh: 右键菜单不能是触发操作的唯一方式，必须提供工具栏按钮或更多操作按钮作为替代。
菜单打开时焦点应移到菜单内第一项。
菜单应支持方向键浏览，Enter/Space 执行，Esc 关闭。
关闭菜单后焦点应回到触发元素（或触发时的位置）。
菜单容器使用 role="menu"，菜单项使用 role="menuitem"。
禁用菜单项应使用 aria-disabled="true"，而非仅视觉变灰。
分隔线应使用 role="separator" 或 hr。
菜单不应超出视口或遮挡关键内容。
对于复杂菜单项可包含 role="menuitemcheckbox" 或 role="menuitemradio"。
不要在触控设备上把长按菜单作为唯一入口，应提供显式菜单按钮。

pattern.tag-chip-input 标签输入组件 标签输入组件组件的无障碍实现模式。 标签输入区域应有 label，可通过 label 元素或 aria-label 提供。 每个已添加的标签应有可访问名称和删除按钮。 删除按钮应有包含标签文本的名称（如"删除 前端"）。 标签应可通过 Backspace/Delete 键删除最后一项。 添加标签时应公告"已添加 XX"，删除时公告"已移除 XX"。 建议列表（如有）应使用 role="listbox"，每项使用 role="option"。 输入框和标签区域之间应有清晰焦点顺序。 标签颜色与背景应满足非文本对比度 (3:1)，且不应仅靠颜色区分标签类别。 不要用 div 模拟删除按钮，必须使用 button 或带角色和名称的元素。 标签数量变化应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live="polite" 公告。 标签输入 标签 多值输入 只用键盘能否添加标签、浏览已添加标签、删除标签。 屏幕阅读器是否能读出已添加的标签和删除按钮名称。 添加和删除是否被动态公告。 标签颜色的对比度是否足够。 输入区有标签和帮助文本，每个标签有删除按钮和名称，操作有动态公告。 输入和标签缺少 label，删除不是按钮，操作无公告。

content.summary_en: Accessible Password Field with Visibility Toggle and Strength component pattern.

content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Password Field with Visibility Toggle and Strength component pattern.
requirements_zh: 密码输入框必须有持久可见的 label。
显示/隐藏密码按钮必须使用 button，并维护 aria-pressed 状态。
按钮的可访问名称应在"显示密码"和"隐藏密码"之间切换。
密码强度指示器应有文本说明（弱/中/强），而不只靠颜色条。
强度条颜色必须满足非文本对比度，且辅以文本标签。
密码要求（长度、字符类型等）应在输入前以文本形式说明，并通过 aria-describedby 关联。
密码不匹配错误应靠近字段显示并关联。
不要使用 placeholder 作为唯一的 label。
允许密码管理器自动填充，使用 autocomplete="new-password" 或 "current-password"。

content.summary_en: Accessible Progress Indicator component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 进度指示器组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Progress Indicator component pattern.
requirements_zh: 确定型进度条使用 progress 元素，设置 max 和 value。
不确定型等待指示器使用 role="progressbar" 且不设 value，并设置 aria-label。
加载完成、出错或超时等状态变化应通过 role="status" 或 aria-live 公告。
不要只用无限旋转的动画表达加载状态，应附带文本（如"正在加载..."）。
加载超时后应提供取消或重试按钮。
进度条颜色必须满足非文本对比度 (3:1)。
页面级加载不要阻塞键盘焦点和辅助技术导航。
对于超过 5 秒的加载过程，应让用户可暂停或取消。

requirements_en: Accessible Notification Center component pattern.
requirements_zh: 通知铃铛按钮必须有可访问名称，包含未读数量（如"通知，3条未读"）。
通知按钮应维护 aria-expanded 并关联到通知面板。
通知面板展开后焦点应移到面板内。
每条通知应有可区分的文本说明（内容摘要和时间）。
未读/已读状态不能只靠颜色或加粗区分，应附加 visual text 或 aria 状态。
一键全部已读或清空按钮必须可键盘操作。
新通知到来时应使用 aria-live 或 role="status" 公告摘要。
Esc 应可关闭通知面板，关闭后焦点回归铃铛按钮。
不要只显示通知数量而不让用户查看详情。

content.summary_en: Accessible Inline Edit component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 行内即时编辑组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Inline Edit component pattern.
requirements_zh: 行内编辑触发器必须是 button，并有可访问名称（如"编辑 姓名，当前值：张三"）。
进入编辑模式后焦点应移到输入框。
输入框必须有 label（可视觉隐藏但辅助技术可见）。
Enter 保存、Esc 取消、Tab/Shift+Tab 在字段间移动。
保存成功或失败应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live 公告。
取消编辑后焦点应返回触发按钮。
输入框长度应根据内容类型合理设置。
不要直接使用 contenteditable 切换而缺少字段标签和键盘支持。

content.summary_en: Accessible OTP / 2FA Verification Code Input component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 验证码/双因素认证输入组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible OTP / 2FA Verification Code Input component pattern.
requirements_zh: 验证码输入必须有 label，说明输入内容和格式（如"6位数字验证码"）。
多个独立输入框应分组并关联（如使用 fieldset 或 role="group"）。
每个独立数字框应有 aria-label（如"第1位"）。
输入时应自动移动焦点到下一位，但不强制（用户可自行导航）。
退格键应可回到上一位并清除。
应支持粘贴整段验证码并自动分配到各框。
倒计时和过期状态应使用 role="timer" 或 aria-live 公告。
重新发送按钮必须可键盘操作并有清楚标签。
错误状态（验证码错误、过期）应通过 aria-describedby 关联并文字说明。
允许通过其他方式验证（如邮件链接、认证器 App）。

横幅不应在用户确认前阻挡整个页面阅读。
不要通过遮盖或模糊内容来迫使选择。

requirements_zh: 粘性导航栏必须保持可键盘访问，不应被其他内容遮挡。
粘性导航应满足焦点不被遮挡 (2.4.11) 的要求，被固定定位元素覆盖时向上滚动暴露。
当前激活的导航项应使用 aria-current="true" 或 aria-current="location"。
激活状态不能只靠颜色或加粗区分，应配合下划线或图标。
导航链接文本应清楚表达目标章节名称。
粘性导航不应占用过多屏幕空间，在放大 400% 时仍可用。
滚动到目标章节后的焦点管理应合理，不要强制移动。
避免高频率滚动事件触发性能问题导致键盘导航卡顿。

触控目标的尺寸不应因虚拟化而缩小。

content.summary_en: Accessible Time Picker component pattern.

requirements_en: Accessible Time Picker component pattern.

时间输入必须有 label 和格式说明（如"HH:MM 24小时制"）。
自定义时间选择器中的小时和分钟输入应有分别的 label。
上下方向键应能调整小时/分钟值。
Enter 确认时间、Esc 关闭选择器。
时间范围错误（如结束早于开始）应通过 aria-describedby 关联错误说明。
提供直接输入时间文本的能力，不只依赖可视化选择器。
AM/PM 切换应可键盘操作。

content.summary_en: Accessible Language / Locale Switcher component pattern.
content.summary_zh: 语言切换器组件的无障碍实现模式。
content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Language / Locale Switcher component pattern.
requirements_zh: html 元素的 lang 属性必须随语言切换更新。
语言选择器应使用原生 select 或语义菜单/按钮组。
控件应有 label，例如"选择语言"或"Switch language"。
当前语言应暴露（如 aria-current="true" 或 select 的默认选中项）。
语言名称应使用对应语言的自称（如"中文""English""日本語"），而非统一用英文。
不应在语言切换时产生页面级闪烁或全页刷新。
切换语言的键盘操作应清晰，不应依赖 hover。
语言切换控件在所有页面中的位置和标识应一致。

good_examples.code: <label for="lang">语言/Language</label><select id="lang" onchange="switchLang()"><option value="zh" selected>中文</option><option value="en">English</option><option value="ja">日本語</option></select>
good_examples.explanation_en: This component example illustrates an accessible or inaccessible interaction pattern.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 使用原生 select 和 label，语言名称以自称展示，切换后更新 lang 属性。

content.summary_en: Accessible Dual Range Slider component pattern.

content.intent_en: Provide a reusable component-level accessibility pattern for code generation.
content.intent_zh: 为代码生成提供可复用的组件级无障碍模式。
requirements_en: Accessible Dual Range Slider component pattern.
requirements_zh: 范围滑块必须有两个可独立操作的滑块控件，每个有 label（如"最低价格""最高价格"）。
每个滑块使用 input type="range" 或带 role="slider" 的完整实现。
当前范围值应实时显示并通过 aria-valuenow、aria-valuemin、aria-valuemax 暴露。
键盘应支持方向键调整每个滑块，Tab 切换滑块，Home/End 跳到边界。
同时提供数字输入框作为精确输入的替代方式。
范围变化应使用 role="status" 或 aria-live 公告（如"价格范围：¥100 - ¥500"）。
滑块轨道颜色不能是区分范围的唯一方式，应附带数值文本。
两个滑块的触控目标应足够大且互不重叠（至少 24x24 CSS 像素）。
不要只用鼠标拖拽作为调整滑块的方式。

source.title_zh: Android 内容标签与可访问名称

content.summary_en: Meaningful Android UI elements need concise labels that describe purpose or result; decorative visuals should be hidden from accessibility services.
content.summary_zh: Android 中有意义的 UI 元素需要简洁、唯一、说明用途或结果的标签；纯装饰图形应从无障碍树中隐藏。
content.intent_en: Expose a reliable accessible name for controls, images, repeated list items, and icon-only actions in Android apps.
content.intent_zh: 让 TalkBack、Switch Access、Voice Access 等辅助技术能理解控件、图片、列表项和图标操作的目的。
requirements_en: For Compose icon-only controls, pass a localized contentDescription to the inner Icon or provide semantics on the clickable parent.
For decorative Compose icons, pass contentDescription = null or hide them with semantics when appropriate.
For Views, set android:contentDescription on meaningful ImageView/ImageButton controls, and use string resources for localization.
Treat logos, brand marks, avatars, profile images, QR codes, maps, charts, photos, covers, and thumbnails as meaningful unless equivalent accessible text already conveys the same information.
Do not hide a meaningful image merely to clear an automated finding; only purely decorative visuals that provide no identity, context, information, or function may be excluded.
Do not include redundant role words such as button or image when the platform already exposes the role.
Repeated list items must have unique labels based on item content, not identical labels such as More or Open.
requirements_zh: Compose 中只有图标的操作控件必须提供本地化 contentDescription，或在可点击父容器上提供语义。
纯装饰 Icon 使用 contentDescription = null，必要时通过 semantics 从无障碍树隐藏。
View/XML 中有意义的 ImageView/ImageButton 使用 android:contentDescription，并引用 strings.xml 以便本地化。
Logo、品牌标志、头像、个人资料图片、二维码、地图、图表、照片、封面和缩略图默认视为有意义内容，除非附近已有等价的可访问文本。
不要为了消除自动检测结果而隐藏有意义图片；只有不提供身份、上下文、信息或功能的纯装饰图形才能排除。
不要在标签中重复“按钮”“图片”等角色词，平台会自动播报角色。
列表中的重复操作必须结合条目内容生成唯一标签，避免所有按钮都叫“更多”或“打开”。

good_examples.title_zh: 带可访问名称的 Compose 图标按钮
good_examples.explanation_en: The icon-only control has a localized accessible name that describes the action.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 只有图标的按钮提供了本地化操作名称，TalkBack 可以读出其用途。

good_examples.title_zh: 带 contentDescription 的 XML 图标按钮
good_examples.code:
<ImageButton
    android:id="@+id/shareButton"
    android:layout_width="48dp"
    android:layout_height="48dp"
    android:src="@drawable/ic_share"
    android:contentDescription="@string/action_share" />
good_examples.explanation_en: The control has an accessible name and a sufficient target size.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 控件既有可访问名称，也有足够的触控区域。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The only visible content is hidden from accessibility services, so the button has no meaningful label.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 唯一可见内容被隐藏，导致按钮没有可理解的读屏标签。

repair_suggestions_en: Add a localized contentDescription to meaningful icons.
Move the label to the clickable parent when an entire row/card is clickable.
Use null contentDescription only for decorative icons that duplicate nearby text.
Before hiding an image, inspect its id, drawable name, nearby text, and page role; identifiers containing logo or brand require a meaningful description by default.
repair_suggestions_zh: 为有意义图标补充本地化 contentDescription。
整行或整卡片可点击时，把标签放在可点击父容器的语义上。
只有当图标纯装饰或已被邻近文本表达时，才使用 null contentDescription。
隐藏图片前检查 id、drawable 名称、邻近文本和页面作用；包含 logo 或 brand 的标识默认必须提供有意义描述。
manual_checks_en: Swipe through the screen with TalkBack and verify each meaningful control has a concise name.
Check repeated list actions; each label should identify the specific item.
Verify decorative icons are not announced redundantly.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 TalkBack 线性滑动，确认每个有意义控件都有简洁名称。
检查列表重复操作，每个标签都应能指向具体条目。
确认装饰图标不会被重复播报。

source.title_zh: Android 触控目标与颜色对比

content.summary_en: Android interactive elements should provide at least a 48dp by 48dp focusable/touchable area and maintain sufficient text and non-text contrast.
content.summary_zh: Android 交互元素应提供至少 48dp x 48dp 的可聚焦/可触控区域，并保证文本和非文本视觉边界有足够对比度。
content.intent_en: Ensure controls can be reliably seen and activated by users with low vision, motor disabilities, or imprecise touch input.
content.intent_zh: 确保低视力、运动障碍或触控不精确的用户也能看清并准确激活控件。
requirements_en: Interactive controls should expose at least a 48dp by 48dp target, even when the visible icon is smaller.
Compose custom controls should use sizeIn(minWidth = 48.dp, minHeight = 48.dp) or a Material component that already enforces minimum target size.
Views should combine minWidth/minHeight and padding to reach the recommended target size.
Normal text should target at least 4.5:1 contrast; large text and major non-text indicators should target at least 3:1.
Do not communicate state or errors only with color.
requirements_zh: 交互控件应暴露至少 48dp x 48dp 的目标区域，即使可见图标本身更小。
Compose 自定义控件使用 sizeIn(minWidth = 48.dp, minHeight = 48.dp)，或优先使用已保证最小尺寸的 Material 组件。
View/XML 中通过 minWidth/minHeight 与 padding 组合达到推荐触控大小。
普通文本对比度目标至少 4.5:1，大文本和关键非文本标识至少 3:1。
不要只用颜色表达状态、错误或分类。

good_examples.title_en: Compose small visual target with large touch area
good_examples.title_zh: Compose 小图标大触控区域
good_examples.explanation_en: The visible icon can stay compact while the clickable area remains large enough.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 图标视觉尺寸可以较小，但实际可点击区域满足触控要求。

bad_examples.title_zh: 过小的自定义点击区域
bad_examples.explanation_en: The clickable target is only 24dp and may be difficult to activate.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 可点击区域只有 24dp，触控精度要求过高。

repair_suggestions_en: Wrap small visuals in a 48dp target container.
Increase minWidth/minHeight or padding on XML controls.
Add text, icon shape, or pattern cues when color communicates state.
repair_suggestions_zh: 把小图标包在至少 48dp 的可点击容器里。
在 XML 控件上增加 minWidth/minHeight 或 padding。
颜色表达状态时，同时增加文字、图标形状或图案提示。
manual_checks_en: Use Accessibility Scanner or ATF to find small touch targets and low contrast.
Try activating controls with one hand and with increased display/font size.
Check whether state remains understandable in grayscale or color-blind previews.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 Accessibility Scanner 或 ATF 检查小触控目标和低对比度。
在字体/显示放大后尝试单手激活控件。
在灰度或色觉缺陷预览下确认状态仍可理解。

content.summary_en: Compose custom UI must expose meaningful semantics: accessible names, roles, states, headings, progress information, pane titles, live regions, and custom actions.
content.summary_zh: Compose 自定义 UI 必须暴露清晰语义，包括名称、角色、状态、标题、进度、窗格标题、实时区域和自定义操作。
content.intent_en: Make the Compose semantics tree match the user's mental model and the available interactions.
content.intent_zh: 让 Compose 语义树与用户看到的界面结构、状态和可执行操作一致。
requirements_en: Prefer built-in Material components because many expose accessibility semantics automatically.
For custom clickable containers, add a role when the role is not obvious from the underlying component.
Use stateDescription for custom state wording, especially switches, filters, selection, and progress.
Use heading semantics for section titles that users should navigate by heading.
Use liveRegion or state announcements for non-focus-moving updates such as result counts, loading completion, or validation summaries.
requirements_zh: 优先使用 Material 内置组件，因为很多语义会自动暴露。
自定义可点击容器在底层类型无法表达角色时，应补充 Role。
对开关、筛选、选中、进度等自定义状态使用 stateDescription。
对需要按标题导航的分区标题标记 heading 语义。
对结果数量、加载完成、校验摘要等不移动焦点的更新使用 liveRegion 或状态播报。

good_examples.title_en: Custom selectable row with role and state
good_examples.title_zh: 带角色和状态的自定义可选行
good_examples.explanation_en: The row exposes switch behavior and its current state.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 整行暴露为开关，并提供当前状态说明。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The row may be announced as generic clickable content without switch role or state.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 整行可能只被播报为普通可点击内容，缺少开关角色和状态。

repair_suggestions_en: Replace custom clickable rows with Switch, Checkbox, Button, Tab, or Slider when possible.
Add semantics role and stateDescription for custom controls.
Use Compose tests to assert semantics properties.
repair_suggestions_zh: 能用 Switch、Checkbox、Button、Tab、Slider 等内置组件时优先替换。
为自定义控件补充 role 与 stateDescription。
用 Compose 测试断言关键语义属性。
manual_checks_en: Inspect the semantics tree with Compose tests or UI Automator.
Use TalkBack and verify name, role, state, and available actions are announced.
Check dynamic state changes without moving focus.
manual_checks_zh: 通过 Compose 测试或 UI Automator 查看语义树。
使用 TalkBack 确认名称、角色、状态和可用操作被正确播报。
检查不移动焦点时的动态状态变化。

source.title_en: Android Focus, Traversal, and Non-touch Operation
source.title_zh: Android 焦点、遍历顺序与非触摸操作

content.summary_en: All important Android workflows must be reachable and operable through TalkBack linear navigation, Switch Access scanning, keyboard/D-pad, and voice-driven selection.
content.summary_zh: Android 主流程必须能通过 TalkBack 线性导航、Switch Access 扫描、键盘/方向键和语音选择完成。
content.intent_en: Keep focus traversal aligned with visual and logical order, and ensure every touch-only action has a non-touch alternative.
content.intent_zh: 让焦点遍历与视觉/逻辑顺序一致，并为所有触摸操作提供非触摸替代方式。
requirements_en: The traversal order should match the logical reading and task order.
Only actionable or meaningful elements should be focusable; purely decorative or structural containers should not create extra stops.
Dialogs, bottom sheets, and new panes should move accessibility focus to an appropriate heading or first useful control.
Gesture-only actions such as swipe-to-delete, drag, pinch, or long-press must have visible selectable alternatives or custom accessibility actions.
For Views, use accessibilityTraversalBefore/After only when layout order cannot be made logical; for Compose, use traversalIndex sparingly.
requirements_zh: 遍历顺序应符合逻辑阅读顺序和任务操作顺序。
只有可操作或有意义元素应进入焦点；纯装饰或结构性容器不应增加额外停靠点。
Dialog、BottomSheet、新窗格出现后，应把无障碍焦点移到合适标题或第一个有效控件。
滑动删除、拖拽、捏合、长按等手势必须提供可见可选择替代操作或自定义无障碍操作。
View 中仅在无法调整布局顺序时使用 accessibilityTraversalBefore/After；Compose 中谨慎使用 traversalIndex。

good_examples.explanation_en: Deletion is available through a selectable button, not only a swipe gesture.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 删除操作可通过按钮完成，不依赖滑动手势。

bad_examples.explanation_en: Users who cannot perform swipe gestures may have no way to delete or dismiss the item.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 无法执行滑动手势的用户可能没有任何删除或关闭方式。

repair_suggestions_en: Add visible buttons or accessibility custom actions for gesture-only behavior.
Remove focusability from decorative containers.
Move focus deliberately when opening modal surfaces or replacing major content.
repair_suggestions_zh: 为仅手势操作补充可见按钮或自定义无障碍操作。
移除装饰容器的可聚焦属性。
打开模态界面或替换主要内容时明确管理焦点。
manual_checks_en: Swipe through the screen with TalkBack and verify the sequence is logical.
Use Switch Access group selection to check whether all and only actionable items are highlighted.
Use a hardware keyboard or D-pad to complete primary flows.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 TalkBack 滑动遍历，确认顺序符合逻辑。
使用 Switch Access 组选择，确认所有且只有可操作项被高亮。
使用硬件键盘或方向键完成主流程。

source.title_en: Android Forms, Hints, Labels, and Errors
source.title_zh: Android 表单、提示、标签与错误反馈

content.summary_en: Android form fields need stable labels, useful hints, programmatic relationships, clear validation errors, and announced status changes.
content.summary_zh: Android 表单字段需要稳定标签、有效提示、程序化关联、清晰错误信息，以及可被辅助技术感知的状态变化。
content.intent_en: Make input purpose and validation feedback understandable before, during, and after user input.
content.intent_zh: 让用户在输入前、输入中和输入后都能理解字段目的与校验反馈。
requirements_en: Compose TextField should use label for stable field identity and placeholder only for examples or format hints.
When a Compose field is invalid, set isError and expose a clear supportingText message near the field.
View EditText should use android:hint for examples and android:labelFor on nearby labels when needed.
Error messages should identify the field, explain the problem, and suggest a fix where possible.
After submit, focus should move to an error summary or the first invalid field when validation fails.
requirements_zh: Compose TextField 使用 label 表达稳定字段名称，placeholder 只用于示例或格式提示。
Compose 字段无效时设置 isError，并在 supportingText 或邻近文本中显示清晰错误。
View/EditText 使用 android:hint 提供示例，必要时用 android:labelFor 关联邻近标签。
错误信息应指出字段、解释问题，并尽可能给出修复建议。
提交失败后，焦点应移动到错误摘要或第一个无效字段。

good_examples.title_en: Compose TextField with label and error
good_examples.title_zh: 带标签和错误提示的 Compose 输入框
good_examples.explanation_en: The field has a stable label, input hint, error state, and visible error text.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 字段有稳定标签、格式提示、错误状态和可见错误文本。

bad_examples.title_zh: 只有占位提示的输入框
bad_examples.explanation_en: The field lacks a stable label once the user starts typing.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 用户开始输入后字段缺少稳定标签。

repair_suggestions_en: Add labels to all input fields.
Expose error state and nearby error text.
Move focus to the first error when a blocking validation failure occurs.
repair_suggestions_zh: 为所有输入字段补充稳定标签。
暴露错误状态并显示邻近错误文本。
阻塞性校验失败时，把焦点移动到第一个错误或错误摘要。
manual_checks_en: With TalkBack, verify field name, value, hint, error state, and error text.
Submit an invalid form and check focus movement.
Confirm instructions do not rely only on color or placeholder text.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 TalkBack 确认字段名称、值、提示、错误状态和错误文本。
提交无效表单，检查焦点移动。
确认说明不只依赖颜色或 placeholder。

source.title_zh: Android 自定义 View 无障碍

content.summary_en: Custom Android Views must implement accessibility node information, events, keyboard/D-pad activation, and virtual child nodes when visual subregions act independently.
content.summary_zh: Android 自定义 View 必须实现无障碍节点信息、事件、键盘/方向键激活；当可视子区域独立操作时，应提供虚拟子节点。
content.intent_en: Make custom drawn or gesture-driven controls understandable and operable by accessibility services.
content.intent_zh: 让自绘或手势驱动控件能被辅助服务理解和操作。
requirements_en: Override performClick for custom touch handling and call it from touch-up activation paths.
Populate AccessibilityNodeInfo with class, text/content description, state, checkable/checked, range, and actions as appropriate.
Send AccessibilityEvent when visible content or control state changes.
Handle D-pad center and Enter consistently with touch activation.
Use ExploreByTouchHelper or an AccessibilityNodeProvider when one custom View contains multiple independently focusable regions.
requirements_zh: 自定义触摸处理必须覆盖 performClick，并在触摸抬起触发路径中调用。
按需在 AccessibilityNodeInfo 中填充类名、文本/内容描述、状态、可选/已选、范围和操作。
可见内容或控件状态变化时发送 AccessibilityEvent。
方向键中键和 Enter 应与触摸激活行为一致。
单个自定义 View 内有多个独立可聚焦区域时，使用 ExploreByTouchHelper 或 AccessibilityNodeProvider 提供虚拟节点。

good_examples.title_zh: 自定义 View 的点击入口
good_examples.explanation_en: performClick gives accessibility services a standard activation path.
good_examples.explanation_zh: performClick 为辅助服务提供标准激活入口。

bad_examples.title_zh: 只有触摸逻辑的自定义控件
bad_examples.explanation_en: The control has no standard accessibility action entry point and may trigger lint warnings.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 控件缺少标准无障碍动作入口，也容易触发 lint 警告。

repair_suggestions_en: Add performClick and call super.performClick.
Populate AccessibilityNodeInfo for custom state and role.
Add virtual view hierarchy for calendars, charts, maps, and custom sliders.
repair_suggestions_zh: 补充 performClick 并调用 super.performClick。
为自定义状态和角色填充 AccessibilityNodeInfo。
为日历、图表、地图、自定义滑块等提供虚拟视图层级。
manual_checks_en: Run Android lint and inspect custom view warnings.
Use UI Automator Viewer to verify speakable text and node boundaries.
Operate the control with TalkBack, keyboard, and D-pad.
manual_checks_zh: 运行 Android lint 并检查自定义 View 警告。
使用 UI Automator Viewer 查看可读文本和节点边界。
使用 TalkBack、键盘和方向键操作该控件。

source.title_zh: Android 列表项与重复操作

content.summary_en: Repeated Android list/card actions need item-specific labels, logical grouping, and clear activation behavior.
content.summary_zh: Android 列表/卡片中的重复操作需要结合条目内容生成标签、合理分组，并清楚表达激活行为。
content.intent_en: Prevent repeated controls from sounding identical and make each row's primary and secondary actions clear.
content.intent_zh: 避免重复控件读起来完全相同，并让每一行的主操作和次操作清楚可辨。
requirements_en: Use item-specific accessible names such as Delete AntennaPod, not Delete.
If the entire row is clickable, expose a single meaningful row action unless child actions need independent focus.
Do not make both the row and all text children separately focusable without a reason.
Overflow buttons must include the item name or context.
When using RecyclerView, bind contentDescription from current item data and avoid stale recycled labels.
requirements_zh: 使用结合条目的名称，例如“删除 AntennaPod”，而不是只有“删除”。
整行可点击时，通常暴露一个有意义的行级操作；只有确实需要时才让子操作独立聚焦。
不要无理由让整行和所有文本子节点都分别进入焦点。
更多/溢出菜单按钮必须包含条目名称或上下文。
RecyclerView 绑定 contentDescription 时必须来自当前条目数据，避免复用导致旧标签残留。

good_examples.title_zh: 结合条目的更多菜单标签
good_examples.explanation_en: The repeated overflow action identifies the item it belongs to.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 重复的更多菜单按钮会说明自己属于哪个条目。

bad_examples.explanation_en: Many items will expose the same label, making navigation ambiguous.

source.title_zh: Android 对话框与底部弹层

content.summary_en: Android dialogs and bottom sheets need a clear title, controlled focus, accessible dismissal, and logical action order.
content.summary_zh: Android 对话框和底部弹层需要清晰标题、受控焦点、可访问关闭方式和符合逻辑的操作顺序。
content.intent_en: Help assistive technology users understand that a new modal surface opened and complete or dismiss it safely.
content.intent_zh: 帮助辅助技术用户理解新的模态界面已打开，并能安全完成或关闭它。
requirements_en: Use AlertDialog, Dialog, ModalBottomSheet, or platform components where possible.
Provide a visible title and expose it as the dialog or pane title.
Move initial focus to the title or first meaningful control when the surface opens.
Provide a clearly named close/cancel action unless dismissal is intentionally blocked.
Return focus to the triggering control after dismissal.
requirements_zh: 尽量使用 AlertDialog、Dialog、ModalBottomSheet 或平台组件。
提供可见标题，并将其暴露为对话框或窗格标题。
弹层打开时把初始焦点移动到标题或第一个有意义控件。
除非业务明确禁止，否则提供名称清楚的关闭/取消操作。
关闭后焦点应回到触发控件。

    dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text(stringResource(R.string.cancel)) } }

source.title_zh: Android 设置页开关与选择控件

content.summary_en: Android settings controls must expose label, role, state, disabled reason, and value changes without relying on visual position or color alone.
content.summary_zh: Android 设置控件必须暴露标签、角色、状态、禁用原因和值变化，不能只依赖视觉位置或颜色。
content.intent_en: Make settings screens efficient for repeated use with screen readers, keyboard, and switch scanning.
content.intent_zh: 让设置页在读屏、键盘和开关扫描中也能高效反复使用。
requirements_en: Use Switch, Checkbox, RadioButton, Slider, or Material equivalents rather than generic clickable rows when possible.
If a whole row toggles a value, expose the row as one toggle control and avoid duplicate focus stops.
State must be programmatically exposed as checked/selected/value, with custom stateDescription only when default wording is insufficient.
Disabled settings should explain why they are unavailable when the reason is not obvious.
Sliders and progress controls must expose current value, range, and step behavior.

For Spinner and other stateful selectors, associate an existing visible label with labelFor. Do not use a fixed contentDescription that can replace the selected value. If no visible label exists, the repair requires a layout-structure or runtime-code change rather than an attribute-only patch.
requirements_zh: 能用 Switch、Checkbox、RadioButton、Slider 或 Material 等价组件时，不要用普通 clickable Row 模拟。
整行切换值时，将整行暴露为一个切换控件，避免重复焦点。
状态必须以 checked/selected/value 等方式程序化暴露；默认播报不足时再加 stateDescription。
禁用设置在原因不明显时应说明不可用原因。
滑块和进度控件必须暴露当前值、范围和步进行为。
Spinner 等有状态选择控件应将现有可见标签通过 labelFor 关联；不要用可能覆盖当前选中值的固定 contentDescription。若不存在可见标签，则需要修改布局结构或运行时代码，不能仅靠属性补丁。

good_examples.title_en: Compose settings row as one switch

good_examples.explanation_en: The row is one switch target and the visual Switch does not add a duplicate action.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 整行是一个开关目标，视觉 Switch 不再创建重复操作。

bad_examples.explanation_en: The row and switch can become separate confusing focus stops for the same action.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 整行和 Switch 可能成为两个重复焦点，表达同一个操作。

repair_suggestions_en: Use toggleable/selectable with the correct role.
Set child switch onCheckedChange to null when the parent row handles toggling.
Add value/range semantics for custom sliders.
For unlabeled Spinners, add or associate a visible label; classify the issue as requiring structure or code when attribute-only XML repair cannot preserve the selected value.
repair_suggestions_zh: 使用 toggleable/selectable 并设置正确角色。
父行处理切换时，将子 Switch 的 onCheckedChange 设为 null。
为自定义滑块补充值和范围语义。
对于无标签 Spinner，应新增或关联可见标签；当仅修改 XML 属性无法保留当前值播报时，将问题归类为需要结构或代码修复。
manual_checks_en: Use TalkBack to verify setting name, role, state, and disabled status.
Toggle values and confirm state changes are announced.
Use Switch Access to check duplicate focus stops.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 TalkBack 确认设置名称、角色、状态和禁用状态。
切换值后确认状态变化会播报。
使用 Switch Access 检查重复焦点。

source.title_zh: Android 搜索、筛选与结果更新

content.summary_en: Android search/filter screens need labelled inputs, explicit clear/filter controls, stable focus, and polite announcements for result updates.
content.summary_zh: Android 搜索/筛选页面需要有标签的输入框、明确的清除/筛选控件、稳定焦点，以及对结果更新的礼貌播报。
content.intent_en: Let users understand what changed after search or filter operations without losing their place.
content.intent_zh: 让用户在搜索或筛选后知道结果如何变化，同时不丢失当前位置。
requirements_en: Search fields need a stable label or hint that identifies the purpose.
Clear buttons and filter chips must have accessible names and selected states.
Do not move focus on every keystroke; announce result count with a live region or status text.
Loading, no results, and error states must be visible and accessible.
Filter drawers or sheets should manage focus like dialogs when modal.

清除按钮和筛选标签必须有可访问名称和选中状态。
不要每次输入都移动焦点；用 live region 或状态文本播报结果数量。
加载、无结果、错误状态必须可见且可访问。
筛选抽屉或底部弹层若为模态，应按对话框方式管理焦点。

repair_suggestions_en: Add result count status with polite live announcement.
Expose selected state on filter chips.
Keep focus stable during incremental search.
repair_suggestions_zh: 增加结果数量状态，并使用礼貌实时播报。
在筛选标签上暴露选中状态。
增量搜索期间保持焦点稳定。
manual_checks_en: Type into search with TalkBack and verify focus remains predictable.
Toggle filters and check selected state and result count announcements.
Test empty, loading, and error states.
manual_checks_zh: 用 TalkBack 输入搜索词，确认焦点稳定可预测。
切换筛选条件，检查选中状态和结果数量播报。
测试空状态、加载状态和错误状态。

source.title_zh: Android 无障碍测试工具链

content.summary_en: Android accessibility evaluation should combine static lint, automated checks, UI hierarchy inspection, TalkBack/Switch Access manual testing, and issue-to-fix mapping.
content.summary_zh: Android 无障碍评估应结合静态 lint、自动化检查、UI 层级检查、TalkBack/Switch Access 手工测试，以及问题到修复策略的映射。
content.intent_en: Use tool feedback as a repair signal while recognizing that automated tools do not catch every screen reader usability problem.
content.intent_zh: 把工具反馈作为修复信号，同时承认自动工具无法覆盖全部读屏可用性问题。
requirements_en: Run Android Lint to catch structural accessibility issues in source code.
Enable Espresso AccessibilityChecks for instrumented flows and root-view checks where appropriate.
Use Accessibility Scanner or ATF-style results to classify content labeling, touch target, contrast, and implementation issues.
Use UI Automator or semantics tree inspection to locate labels, roles, states, and focusable nodes.
Always include TalkBack and Switch Access manual checks for representative user flows.
requirements_zh: 运行 Android Lint 捕获源码结构层面的无障碍问题。
在关键仪器测试流程中启用 Espresso AccessibilityChecks，必要时从根视图检查。
使用 Accessibility Scanner 或 ATF 风格结果分类内容标签、触控目标、对比度和实现问题。
使用 UI Automator 或语义树检查定位标签、角色、状态和可聚焦节点。
代表性用户流程必须包含 TalkBack 和 Switch Access 手工检查。

good_examples.title_zh: 启用 Espresso 无障碍检查
good_examples.explanation_en: Instrumented actions trigger accessibility checks across the screen hierarchy.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 仪器测试中的操作会触发屏幕层级的无障碍检查。

bad_examples.explanation_en: Successful compilation does not prove the UI is accessible or usable with assistive technology.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 编译成功并不能证明界面对辅助技术可访问或可用。

repair_suggestions_en: Map content labeling findings to contentDescription or semantics repairs.
Map touch target findings to min size and padding repairs.
Map implementation findings to focus order, role/state, custom view, and traversal repairs.
repair_suggestions_zh: 将内容标签问题映射到 contentDescription 或 semantics 修复。
将触控目标问题映射到最小尺寸和 padding 修复。
将实现类问题映射到焦点顺序、角色/状态、自定义 View 和遍历顺序修复。
manual_checks_en: Record before/after issue counts by category and severity.
For each selected app screen, verify build, launch, navigation, tool scan, and manual TalkBack flow.
Report automated-zero results as zero detected issues, not as proof of complete accessibility.
manual_checks_zh: 按类别和严重程度记录修复前后问题数量。
每个选定界面都验证构建、启动、导航、工具扫描和 TalkBack 手工流程。
自动检测为 0 时表述为“工具可检测问题为 0”，不要直接说完全无障碍。

Row(

Make the child Switch passive by setting onCheckedChange = null.
Verify TalkBack announces one name, one role, and one state.

source.title_zh: Android XML 电话输入框缺少输入类型

content.summary_en: When stable XML evidence identifies a field as a telephone-number field and inputType is absent, set android:inputType to phone so Android exposes phone-number input semantics and an appropriate IME.
content.summary_zh: 当稳定 XML 证据明确表明字段用于输入电话号码且 inputType 缺失时，设置 android:inputType="phone"，使 Android 暴露电话输入语义并提供合适键盘。
content.intent_en: Add phone input semantics without changing the accessible label, accepted value format, validation, or layout structure.
content.intent_zh: 补充电话输入语义，同时不改变可访问标签、可接受值格式、校验或布局结构。
requirements_en: Repair only when an id, label, TextInputLayout hint, or equivalent stable XML evidence identifies a telephone-number value.
Set android:inputType="phone" when the attribute is absent.
Do not treat an SMS body, contact name, extension description, generic number, or search field as a telephone-number field.
Do not replace phone with number; phone numbers can contain dialing characters and are not arithmetic values.
Preserve digits, maxLength, country-code guidance, ids, labels, validators, and event handlers.
If existing restrictions conflict with phone input, require review instead of overwriting them.
requirements_zh: 只有 id、标签、TextInputLayout hint 或等价稳定 XML 证据明确表示电话号码值时才修复。
属性缺失时设置 android:inputType="phone"。
不要把短信正文、联系人姓名、分机说明、普通数字或搜索字段当作电话号码字段。
不要用 number 代替 phone；电话号码可能包含拨号字符，并非算术数值。
保留 digits、maxLength、国家区号提示、id、标签、校验器和事件处理。
已有输入限制与 phone 冲突时应转人工复核，不要覆盖。

good_examples.title_en: Phone field with purpose and input semantics
good_examples.title_zh: 具有用途标签和电话输入语义
good_examples.code:
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/contact_phone"
    android:hint="@string/phone_number"
    android:inputType="phone" />
good_examples.explanation_en: The label communicates purpose and phone requests the telephone-oriented IME.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 标签说明用途，phone 请求面向电话号码的输入键盘。

bad_examples.title_en: Phone field left as generic text
bad_examples.title_zh: 电话字段仍使用普通文本语义
bad_examples.explanation_en: The purpose is clear, but the input method remains generic.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 字段用途明确，但输入方式仍为普通文本。

repair_suggestions_en: Add only android:inputType="phone" when telephone purpose is unambiguous.
Preserve labels, restrictions, ids, validation, and event behavior.
Reject generic numeric evidence instead of assuming it is a phone number.
repair_suggestions_zh: 只有电话用途无歧义时才添加 android:inputType="phone"。
保留标签、输入限制、id、校验和事件行为。
拒绝仅凭普通数字证据推断电话号码。
manual_checks_en: Confirm the field collects a telephone number rather than another numeric or text value.
Confirm the phone-oriented keyboard and accepted dialing characters at runtime.
manual_checks_zh: 确认字段收集电话号码，而不是其他数字或文本。
确认运行时电话键盘和允许的拨号字符。

source.title_en: Android XML Numeric Field Missing Input Type
source.title_zh: Android XML 数值输入框缺少输入类型

content.summary_en: When stable XML evidence identifies a field as a numeric value and inputType is absent, choose number or numberDecimal from the field's purpose and preserve any explicit range or character restrictions.
content.summary_zh: 当稳定 XML 证据明确表明字段用于输入数值且 inputType 缺失时，应根据字段用途选择 number 或 numberDecimal，并保留明确的范围或字符限制。
content.intent_en: Expose numeric input semantics without silently changing whether fractions, signs, units, or formatted identifiers are accepted.
content.intent_zh: 补充数值输入语义，同时不擅自改变小数、符号、单位或格式化标识符的接受规则。
requirements_en: Repair only when an id, label, TextInputLayout hint, or equivalent stable XML evidence identifies a specific numeric purpose such as age, count, quantity, amount, price, or measurement.
Use number for integer-only values such as age or count when XML evidence does not allow fractions.
Use numberDecimal only when the purpose or existing restrictions clearly allow fractional values such as amount, price, weight, or measurement.
Add numberSigned only when negative values are explicitly supported; do not infer signed input from a generic number label.
Do not convert phone numbers, postal codes, account identifiers, one-time codes, or free-form formatted values into arithmetic numeric fields.
Preserve digits, maxLength, min/max validation evidence, ids, labels, units, and event handlers; require review when decimal behavior is ambiguous.
requirements_zh: 只有 id、标签、TextInputLayout hint 或等价稳定 XML 证据明确表示年龄、计数、数量、金额、价格或测量值等具体数值用途时才修复。
年龄或计数等仅允许整数的字段使用 number。
只有用途或现有限制明确允许小数时，金额、价格、重量或测量字段才使用 numberDecimal。
只有明确支持负值时才添加 numberSigned，不能根据普通数字标签推断。
不要把电话号码、邮政编码、账户标识、一次性验证码或自由格式值转换为算术数值字段。
保留 digits、maxLength、最小最大值校验证据、id、标签、单位和事件处理；小数行为不明确时转人工复核。

good_examples.code:
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/user_age"
    android:hint="@string/age"
    android:inputType="number" />
good_examples.explanation_en: Age is identified as an integer value, so number is the bounded repair.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 年龄被明确为整数值，因此 number 是受限修复。

good_examples.code:
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/expense_amount"
    android:hint="@string/amount"
    android:inputType="numberDecimal" />
good_examples.explanation_en: The amount purpose supports fractional input, so numberDecimal preserves expected behavior.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 金额用途支持小数输入，因此 numberDecimal 保持预期行为。

bad_examples.title_en: Numeric purpose left as generic text
bad_examples.title_zh: 数值用途仍使用普通文本语义
bad_examples.explanation_en: The XML identifies an age value, but the field does not expose numeric input semantics.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: XML 已明确年龄数值用途，但字段没有暴露数值输入语义。

repair_suggestions_en: Choose number or numberDecimal from stable purpose and restriction evidence.
Preserve digits, maxLength, units, ids, labels, validators, and event behavior.
Reject ambiguous identifiers and formatted codes instead of treating every digit string as arithmetic input.
repair_suggestions_zh: 根据稳定用途和输入限制证据选择 number 或 numberDecimal。
保留 digits、maxLength、单位、id、标签、校验器和事件行为。
拒绝有歧义的标识符和格式化代码，不要把所有数字字符串当作算术输入。
manual_checks_en: Confirm whether the value permits fractions or negative numbers.
Confirm the numeric keyboard and validation behavior at runtime.
manual_checks_zh: 确认该值是否允许小数或负数。
确认运行时数字键盘和校验行为。

source.title_en: Android XML Format Example Used as the Only Input Label
source.title_zh: Android XML 仅用格式示例作为输入标签

content.summary_en: A phone number, numeric sample, plus sign, or other format example does not by itself explain an input field's purpose. Keep the example as guidance, but provide a stable purpose label through TextInputLayout, labelFor, or a purpose-specific hint.
content.summary_zh: 电话号码、数字样例、加号等格式示例本身不能说明输入框用途。可以保留示例作为格式指导，但必须通过 TextInputLayout、labelFor 或用途明确的 hint 提供稳定标签。
content.intent_en: Replace an example-only accessible name with a purpose label while preserving useful format guidance and input behavior.
content.intent_zh: 用用途标签替代仅由示例构成的可访问名称，同时保留有用的格式指导和输入行为。
requirements_en: The accessible label must describe what users enter, not only show a syntactically valid example.
Prefer an existing visible TextView with android:labelFor or a TextInputLayout hint when one already represents the field purpose.
A TextView that owns android:labelFor does not need a new android:id; point labelFor to the input's existing id using @id/name, never @+id/name.
When no separate visible label exists, use a concise purpose-specific android:hint and keep format help in nearby helper text when possible.
Do not invent a field purpose from a generic numeric value alone.
Preserve inputType, digits, maxLength, validators, ids, and event handlers.
requirements_zh: 可访问标签必须说明用户要输入什么，不能只展示语法正确的示例。
已有可见 TextView 或 TextInputLayout 表达字段用途时，优先使用 android:labelFor 或父级 hint。
设置 android:labelFor 的 TextView 本身不需要新增 android:id；应使用 @id/name 引用输入框已有 id，不能使用 @+id/name。
没有独立可见标签时，使用简洁且说明用途的 android:hint；可能时把格式示例保留为附近辅助文本。
不要仅根据一个普通数字推断字段用途。
保留 inputType、digits、maxLength、校验器、id 和事件处理。

good_examples.title_zh: 用途标签与格式指导分离
good_examples.code:
<TextView
    android:text="@string/phone_number"
    android:labelFor="@id/phone_input" />
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/phone_input"
    android:hint="@string/phone_example"
    android:inputType="phone" />
good_examples.explanation_en: The label communicates purpose; the hint can remain a format example.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 标签说明字段用途，hint 可以继续提供格式示例。

bad_examples.title_zh: 仅由示例构成的可访问名称
bad_examples.explanation_en: The example shows a format but does not identify that the field is a phone-number field.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 该示例只展示格式，没有说明这是电话号码字段。

repair_suggestions_en: Use stable XML evidence such as id, visible text, parent TextInputLayout hint, or inputType to identify the purpose.
Associate an existing visible label with labelFor when available.
Otherwise replace the example-only hint with a localized purpose hint without changing input restrictions.
repair_suggestions_zh: 使用 id、可见文本、父 TextInputLayout hint 或 inputType 等稳定 XML 证据判断用途。
存在可见标签时用 labelFor 建立关联。
否则用本地化用途 hint 替换仅由示例构成的 hint，同时保持输入限制不变。
manual_checks_en: Confirm the inferred purpose using visible labels or source context when XML evidence is ambiguous.
Verify TalkBack announces the field purpose before the current value.
manual_checks_zh: XML 证据存在歧义时，结合可见标签或源码上下文确认用途。
确认 TalkBack 会在当前值之前播报字段用途。

source.title_en: Android XML Standard Control Explicitly Not Focusable
source.title_zh: Android XML 标准交互控件被显式设为不可聚焦

content.summary_en: Framework interactive widgets such as Button, ImageButton, and EditText are focusable by default. When an enabled visible standard control explicitly declares android:focusable="false", remove that override to restore default keyboard and D-pad navigation.
content.summary_zh: Button、ImageButton、EditText 等框架交互控件默认可聚焦。启用且可见的标准控件显式声明 android:focusable="false" 时，应移除该覆盖以恢复默认键盘和方向键导航。
content.intent_en: Restore the framework's default focus behavior with the smallest XML edit and without changing click listeners, ids, hierarchy, or visual layout.
content.intent_zh: 通过最小 XML 修改恢复框架默认焦点行为，不改变点击监听、id、层级或视觉布局。
requirements_en: Apply automatically only to enabled, visible, standard semantic controls whose framework class is focusable by default.
Prefer removing the explicit android:focusable="false" attribute so the widget regains its default behavior.
Do not blindly set focusable=true on decorative images, disabled controls, hidden views, containers, or unknown custom views.
Preserve click handlers, ids, dimensions, hierarchy, content descriptions, and directional focus attributes.
Custom views and controls whose focus is managed in code require source or runtime review.
requirements_zh: 仅对启用、可见且框架默认可聚焦的标准语义控件自动修复。
优先移除显式 android:focusable="false"，让控件恢复框架默认行为。
不要盲目给装饰图片、禁用控件、隐藏视图、容器或未知自定义 View 设置 focusable=true。
保留点击处理、id、尺寸、层级、内容描述和方向焦点属性。
由代码管理焦点的自定义 View 或控件需要源码或运行时复核。

good_examples.title_en: Use the standard ImageButton focus behavior
good_examples.title_zh: 使用 ImageButton 默认焦点行为
good_examples.code:
<ImageButton
    android:id="@+id/move_left"
    android:layout_width="48dp"
    android:layout_height="48dp"
    android:contentDescription="@string/move_left" />
good_examples.explanation_en: Omitting the false override lets the standard interactive widget remain keyboard and D-pad focusable.
good_examples.explanation_zh: 移除 false 覆盖后，标准交互控件保持键盘和方向键可聚焦。

bad_examples.title_en: Enabled ImageButton removed from focus navigation
bad_examples.title_zh: 启用的 ImageButton 被排除在焦点导航之外
bad_examples.explanation_en: The control can still receive touch clicks but cannot receive normal keyboard or D-pad focus.
bad_examples.explanation_zh: 控件仍可触摸点击，但无法通过普通键盘或方向键获得焦点。

repair_suggestions_en: Remove android:focusable="false" from the confirmed standard interactive control.
Do not add unrelated labels, dimensions, roles, or event handlers in the same repair.
Verify Tab and directional navigation after rebuilding the App.
repair_suggestions_zh: 从已确认的标准交互控件移除 android:focusable="false"。
不要在同一修复中添加无关标签、尺寸、角色或事件处理。
重新构建后验证 Tab 和方向键导航。
manual_checks_en: Navigate to the control with Tab and D-pad keys.
Confirm touch and click behavior is unchanged.
manual_checks_zh: 使用 Tab 和方向键导航到该控件。
确认触摸和点击行为保持不变。
